experiences.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
experiences.description: Explore one of the world's greatest art collections, culminating in Michelangelo's breathtaking Sistine Chapel ceiling. Book skip-the-line tickets in advance to maximize your time among thousands of masterpieces spanning centuries of artistic achievement.

experiences.name: Trastevere Food & Wine Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the charming cobblestone streets of Trastevere sampling supplì (fried rice balls), artisanal cheeses, cured meats, and local Roman wines. Join a guided small-group tour or explore independently hitting local trattorias and street food vendors beloved by Romans.

experiences.name: Borghese Gallery Art Experience
experiences.description: Discover Bernini's stunning sculptures and Caravaggio's dramatic paintings in this intimate and world-class gallery set within a beautiful villa. Entry is strictly timed and limited to 360 visitors per session, making it an exclusive and immersive art encounter.

experiences.name: Pasta-Making Class in Prati
experiences.description: Learn to hand-craft authentic Roman pasta dishes like cacio e pepe and carbonara under the guidance of a local nonna or professional chef. You'll leave with hands-on skills, a full belly, and recipes to recreate these classics back home.

experiences.name: Campo de' Fiori Market & Ghetto Culinary Stroll
experiences.description: Start at the vibrant Campo de' Fiori morning market to browse fresh produce, spices, and local specialties, then walk into the historic Jewish Ghetto to taste Roman-Jewish cuisine gems like carciofi alla giudia (fried artichokes) and ricotta-filled pastries at century-old bakeries.
experiences.location: Campo de' Fiori & Jewish Ghetto, historic center
